name: Distribution
definition: Distributions in cash and/or securities following a corporate event.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date/time at which the event or part of the event, for example, an option, becomes valid and should be processed and/or applied to holdings.

EventConditions.name: Event Conditions
EventConditions.definition: Conditions that the issuer has placed on the completion of the event, for example, tender percentage required.

ExDate.name: Ex Date
ExDate.definition: Date/time as from which trading (including exchange and OTC trading) occurs on the underlying security without the benefit.

GrossRate.name: Gross Rate
GrossRate.definition: Percentage paid before deductions and/or allowances have been made.

MeetingDate.name: Meeting Date
MeetingDate.definition: Date/time at which the meeting will take place.

NetRate.name: Net Rate
NetRate.definition: Percentage paid after deductions and/or allowances have been made.

NewFaceValue.name: New Face Value
NewFaceValue.definition: New unit value of a debt security.

NewParValue.name: New Par Value
NewParValue.definition: New nominal value of an equity security.

PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date/time at which the distribution is due to take place (cash and/or securities).

CorporateActionOption.name: Corporate Action Option
CorporateActionOption.definition: Specifies information about the choices offered to the holder of a corporate action.

CurrencyOption.name: Currency Option
CurrencyOption.definition: Currency choice given to the investor.

DecreaseAmount.name: Decrease Amount
DecreaseAmount.definition: Amount by which the issuer devalues a share  (in a decrease value event).

DecreaseRate.name: Decrease Rate
DecreaseRate.definition: Amount, expressed as a percentage, by which the issuer devalues a share  (in a decrease value event).

OfferPriceFixingDate.name: Offer Price Fixing Date
OfferPriceFixingDate.definition: Date/time at which an offer price is determined (as compared to its reset date if applicable).

ExercisePeriod.name: Exercise Period
ExercisePeriod.definition: Period during which the right and/or privilege on an underlying financial instrument may be executed.

OfferPeriod.name: Offer Period
OfferPeriod.definition: Period during which an open offer remains valid.

TradingPeriod.name: Trading Period
TradingPeriod.definition: Period during which a financial instrument is available for trading.

BlockingPeriod.name: Blocking Period
BlockingPeriod.definition: Period, set by the issuer, during which the security is blocked, ie, not available for exchange.

InterestPeriod.name: Interest Period
InterestPeriod.definition: Period during which interest has accrued.

DistributionTax.name: Distribution Tax
DistributionTax.definition: Provides the tax description associated with the corporate event.

OfferPrice.name: Offer Price
OfferPrice.definition: Price, determined by the offerer, at which the investor is entitled to take part in an event.

IncentivePremium.name: Incentive Premium
IncentivePremium.definition: Cash premium made available to encourage participation by a certain deadline (avoids to have a second call).
